purpose: Spinosad is used to treat head lice infestations in adults and children. It kills lice and their eggs so they cannot spread or grow. It is applied directly to the scalp and hair.
how_it_works: Spinosad works by attacking the nervous system of lice, causing them to become paralyzed and die. It also kills lice eggs, which helps stop new lice from hatching. Because it targets the lice directly, it does not significantly affect the human body.
common_side_effects: The most common side effects are mild and include redness, irritation, or dryness of the scalp. Some people may notice eye redness if the product accidentally gets in the eyes. These effects are usually temporary and go away on their own.
warnings: Avoid getting this medication in your eyes — rinse thoroughly with water if contact occurs. Do not use it on broken, cut, or infected skin. It contains benzyl alcohol, which should not be used in newborns or premature infants due to risk of serious reactions. Always follow your doctor or pharmacist's instructions carefully.
typical_dosing: Apply enough of the lotion to cover the entire dry scalp and hair, then leave it on for 10 minutes before rinsing off with warm water. A second treatment may be needed after 7 days if live lice are still seen. It is usually used once or twice total, not as a daily medication.
